appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: Choose how axomail looks. "System" follows your operating system's light or dark setting.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Choose the language axomail uses. "System default" follows your operating system's language.
language.statusUnavailable: Changing the language needs the desktop app; it is unavailable in the browser preview.

folderView.label: Folder view
folderView.favoritesEmptyHint: Open a folder's menu and choose "Add to Favorites".

retention.title: Message retention
retention.hint: Limit how much mail is kept in this folder. Starred messages are always kept.
retention.modeByCount: Keep a maximum number of messages
retention.actionHint: "Move to Trash" relocates over-limit messages to Trash — never a permanent server delete. "Remove the local copy only" drops the cached body; nothing leaves the server and it is re-fetched on demand.
retention.saveFailed: Could not save the retention policy.
retention.applied: Retention applied: {trashed} moved to Trash, {purged} local copies removed.
retention.unavailable: Retention needs the desktop app; it is unavailable in the browser preview.
